page_title: CRY 3-0 BUR | Crystal Palace v Burnley 24/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+12' Burnley have a corner.
90+12' 12:2 – the corner kicks stats.
90+10' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Crystal Palace.
90+9' Here comes a substitution. Jordan Ayew is given a rest as he is replaced by David Ozoh (Crystal Palace).
90+7' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) was quite harsh and Lewis Smith didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+6' The current number of shots on goal is 6:0.
90+2' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
90+1' Substitution. James Tomkins (Crystal Palace) has come on for Joachim Andersen.
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and David Datro Fofana trots off the pitch and is replaced by Jay Rodriguez (Burnley).
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jack Cork (Burnley) comes onto the pitch for Johann Berg Gudmundsson.
90' Here is a change. Wilson Odobert is going off and Vincent Kompany gives the last tactical orders to Benson Manuel Hedilazio (Burnley).
90' The fourth official shows 12 min. of added time.
89' After what seems an eternity, referee Lewis Smith decides there was an offside after using VAR to review the goal! NO GOAL for Burnley, play to continue.
88' The Burnley players halt their celebrations as referee Lewis Smith makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
87' An unlucky rebound falls to David Datro Fofana (Burnley) and he scores with a bullet header.
85' Maxime Esteve (Burnley) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
84' Burnley are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
79' 3 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper James Trafford no chance!
79' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
78' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty!
77' Celebrations by Crystal Palace are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
76' Lewis Smith has a clear sight and sees a foul from Vitinho (Burnley). The referee blows his whistle and awards Crystal Palace a penalty after chaos inside the box.
75' Vincent Kompany decides to make a substitution. Charlie Taylor will be replaced by Vitinho (Burnley).
74' Lewis Smith sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
73' Wait! Referee Lewis Smith has indicated he is going to review the Crystal Palace goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

71' 2 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Matheus Franca, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace), who beats James Trafford with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
70' The game is interrupted as Lorenz Assignon (Burnley) is flagged offside.
68' 1 - 0 Goal! Jordan Ayew picks out Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) in the box with a decent cross, and he scores in the right side of the goal with a header from close range. 1:0.
68' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Crystal Palace comes to nothing.

67' Naouirou Ahamada (Crystal Palace) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the right side of the goal, but James Trafford makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best! The referee blows his whistle, Crystal Palace are awarded a corner kick.
66' Oliver Glasner prepares a substitution. Odsonne Edouard is replaced by Matheus Franca (Crystal Palace).
66' Substitution. Naouirou Ahamada (Crystal Palace) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Adam Wharton walks off.
62' The Crystal Palace players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
58' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
57' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) jumps into a tackle and Lewis Smith signals a foul.
53' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
50' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) is given a yellow card.
48' The Crystal Palace players are exchanging some short passes.
47' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' Lewis Smith has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Burnley can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' The current number of offsides is 4:1.
44' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
40' The referee signals a corner kick to Crystal Palace.
40' Crystal Palace keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
37' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) failed to convert a mid-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
37' Here is the reaction to a red card. Vincent Kompany makes a tactical substitution, Zeki Amdouni leaves the pitch and Josh Cullen (Burnley) comes on.
36' The ref’s original red card decision for Josh Brownhill (Burnley) is upheld after a VAR review!

36' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Josh Brownhill (Burnley), but referee Lewis Smith must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
35' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) makes a horrible challenge on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!

28' What a save from James Trafford! Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the left post, but the goalkeeper has pulled off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
28' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) takes the corner which is cleared.
28' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
27' Crystal Palace control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
24' A quickly taken corner by Crystal Palace.
21' The percentage of ball possession is – 58:42.
18' Crystal Palace force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
18' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) will deliver the corner kick.
14' Neat passing move from Burnley in order to create new attacking opportunities.
10' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Crystal Palace.
9' Crystal Palace seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
7' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
6' David Datro Fofana (Burnley) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
5' Crystal Palace have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
5' David Datro Fofana (Burnley) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
4' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
4' Crystal Palace enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

2' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) latches on to the corner kick and releases a quick strike from the edge of the box. The result differs significantly from his intention as the ball flies way over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
1' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
